findings.desc: CHK-003 userSees promises `recall --story <id>` prints a ranked top-N list, but the CLI schema in packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:1763-1767 only registers --storyId (not --story). Running `lattice recall --story B-7561` silently drops the flag and returns the usage message instead of results. The handler (handlers/recall.ts:136) does `args.storyId ?? args.story` but the CLI arg parser never populates args.story because the schema has no `story` field. The smoke test bypasses this by calling h.recall({storyId:...}) directly. Fix: add `story: z.string().optional()` alias in the recall schema in cli-engine.ts, or rename storyId to story to match the documented flag name.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 605d5123: F-001 added story alias to the recall cli-engine schema (recall --story now runs, verified at CLI); F-002 named smoke for 121-candidate ranking (#1 correct); F-003 named smoke for malformed/partial profiles no-crash. Smoke 24/24.

findings.desc: CHK-002:adversarial:0 lacks a concrete verificationEvidence binding: the intent requires a 100+ profile large-candidate-set performance + correct-ranking test, but the evidence note says only "Smoke: recallSimilarStories most-similar-first over the story_list scan, top-N respected, zero-score dropped, target self excluded, empty candidates -> []" — it names no perf/large-set assertion. The smoke file contains no named check block testing recallSimilarStories with 100+ candidates. Evidence must concretely correspond to the intent behavior it claims to cover.

CHK-002:adversarial:2 lacks a concrete verificationEvidence binding: the intent requires that recallSimilarStories with candidates containing malformed/partial profiles (missing keywords, missing fileKinds) does not crash. The evidence note says only "Smoke: recallSimilarStories most-similar-first over the story_list scan, top-N respected, zero-score dropped, target self excluded, empty candidates -> []" — it names no malformed-input crash-guard assertion. The smoke file contains no named check block passing partial/missing-field profiles into recallSimilarStories. Evidence must concretely correspond to the intent behavior it claims to cover.
